status: heuristic candidate inventory; human classification required; not a locale bundle or proof of complete ARC-13 coverage
method: Lexical scan of quoted literals in runtime JavaScript, skipping line/block comments. Captures ordinary and template literals, including interpolated templates as raw candidate text. Heuristic includes UI-context literals and any literal containing whitespace; intentionally over-inclusive. It does not parse AST/regex literals, runtime DOM generation, dynamic expressions, or fully decode JS escapes. One candidate is truncated at 350 characters and flagged for source readback. The low-volume manual batch links exact lexical occurrences in 22 small runtime sources; other classifications may describe conceptual templates spanning several lexical fragments. The public menu/economy batch links exact candidate occurrences; editorial card copy and technical DOM identifiers remain separately classified. The core validation/admin batch links exact occurrences in four additional shared-core sources. The shared scene-component source is fully classified: exact technical candidates are linked to the supplement, and the hotspot text template is mapped to the semantic accessible-name entry in the viewer/configurator batch.

candidates.currentText: Estimativa comercial sujeita à validação final de medidas, instalação e disponibilidade.
Concentrar a compra de chapas, ferragens e outros insumos em mais pedidos ajuda a negociar com fornecedores e programar as aquisições.
Diferentes apartamentos compartilham uma plataforma técnica, sem exigir que todos escolham a mesma composição. Materiais e processos comuns podem ser planejados juntos.
Projetos individuais exigem programação de máquinas, detalhamento e planos de corte próprios. Os módulos previamente desenvolvidos permitem organizar etapas repetíveis.
Planos de corte organizados ajudam a distribuir melhor as peças nas chapas e reduzir sobras, sem diminuir a qualidade dos materiais.
